subject.title: fix(browser): persist managed Chrome cookies across restarts

question: Should OpenClaw accept `--use-mock-keychain` as the default for newly created local macOS headless managed Chrome profiles to preserve Chrome-owned cookies across restarts?
rationale: The implementation avoids the rejected plaintext sidecar and preserves existing profile backends, but it intentionally changes a sensitive credential-storage boundary for new managed profiles.

options.title: Accept Current Shape
options.body: Merge this design after owner approval because it keeps cookie material in Chrome profile storage and proves both fresh and upgraded profiles.

options.title: Require Explicit Opt-In
options.body: Ask for a patch that keeps graceful close but gates mock-keychain persistence behind a documented user or setup choice.

options.title: Reject This Direction
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers do not want mock-keychain-backed durable cookies as default product behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept Current Shape
recommendation.body: Merge this design after owner approval because it keeps cookie material in Chrome profile storage and proves both fresh and upgraded profiles.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest browser-runtime history and previously reviewed the rejected cookie sidecar approach for this same behavior.
